exposure: Stapled transanal rectal resection (STARR) for obstructed defecation syndrome (ODS)
outcome: Longo's ODS score before and after surgery
cohort: 30 females undergoing STARR for the treatment of ODS
finding: While the ODS score before surgery was higher in the C/S group, there was no significant difference in ODS score improvement after STARR between the VD and C/S groups, suggesting C/S may not protect against pelvic organ trauma.
mod_finding: C-section did not appear to protect against obstructed defecation syndrome, and episiotomy may have a protective effect during vaginal delivery.
